chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Recording producers and Boston bookings
summary: John Hammond arranged records; Stribling Brothers booked New England tours.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: While you were with Fletcher's band you recorded some records with him. Do you remember some of the people who were in charge of recording records at that time? You mentioned John Hammond was there? Did you only record for John Hammond or were there other people who were responsible for putting together musicians to make a record?
John Hammond was the only one?

Someone else - I can't think of his name. This was up in Boston. Stribling Brothers. They did all the booking up in Boston. Booked all the bands up there, Stribling Brothers, 'cause if we'd go up there, you know, we wouldn't go for a night or something like that. We'd make a tour through New England.
